Core Style (High-Fidelity Oil Painting):
Masterful oil painting on canvas. The entire image must feature distinct, layered impressionist brushstrokes and rich paint textures. Avoid a flat digital look or raw photorealism; it must be clearly recognizable as a handcrafted oil painting.

Fidelity & Text Oil Fusion:
Strictly maintain the original composition, background, and color palette of the source photo. The original names and text characters must be embedded directly into the paint layer using a thick impasto technique. **Strictly no digital drop shadows, no black outer glows, and no artificial text formatting.** Any shadow cast by the text must be rendered purely as physical 3D paint relief and brush ridges on the canvas. The edges of the font must naturally blend and bleed into the surrounding background canvas. The text must remain clear and readable, but explicitly rendered as thick physical paint, not as a digital overlay. Keep the original soft white gradient blurring at the bottom completely intact.

Execution Rules:
1.Face & Likeness: Achieve an absolute perfect likeness of the subject. Render the facial features and expressions with high-precision painterly realism using fine, visible oil brushstrokes. Preserve the exact bone structure and eyes without blurring them into abstract shapes.

2.Hair & Details: Follow the exact natural flow, volume, and shape of the original hair. Use directional brush movements to define the hair strands and highlights, ensuring it retains its authentic structure while being rendered in rich oil paint.

3.Clothing & Background: Apply broad, expressive "wet-on-wet" blending and visible bristle marks to the clothing and background, perfectly matching the original source elements with an artistic touch.
